newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica robbers loot car as hurt passenger watches.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica robbers loot car as hurt passenger watches.

text.p: A man injured in a car crash in South Africa watched helplessly as passing motorists and a pedestrian looted cash and liquor from his vehicle, police said on Wednesday.
A statement said the driver of the car was killed when it spun out of control on a highway near Cape Town on Tuesday evening, landing on its roof.
The passenger, who suffered head injuries, said two men in a passing car stopped and searched the luggage, taking liquor, clothes, cash and a briefcase.
A pedestrian also helped himself to goods thrown from the vehicle when it overturned. He was arrested on the highway later, police said.
